correctness.rationale: A multipath has ≤n−1 arcs, so K=X(G) is at most d=n−2 dimensional. The closed star of added arc b is a contractible cone A. The top relative simplices C_d(K,A) are exactly Hamiltonian s→t paths avoiding b; each such facet has all codimension-one faces in A since deleting any path arc destroys its s-to-t route, so the relative differential vanishes. For each P the missing Hamiltonian directed cycle P+b has all proper subsets in K, and its formal simplex boundary is a genuine embedded d-sphere with relative class ±[P], proving the full integral isomorphism. Collapsing the (d−1)-skeleton and projecting onto these selected P facets produces r; the wedge inclusion i of cycle boundaries has r∘i degree one on each sphere and no cross-terms, also for d=1. Independently enumerated all 136 source/sink allowed digraphs for n=3,4 and checked mod-two top chain nullity equals h; this finite check supports but does not prove the general integral theorem. No claim to calculate all lower-dimensional homology.
